problems: The Elenchus prints numbers only in a detached block (715, Ibid., 833, 917, 923) with fewer numbers than titles; mapping to Observationes/Libri/Descriptio/Adversus eos is inferred from the body and the Ordo.

The title page of the Observationes (cols 713-716) is missing from the OCR; the first Glossarium text is at line 52444 (page 715|716 by header count), so Observationes and Liber primus have no head line, only a page-count position. The pg-colfind map jumps 710 to 723 there.
Ordo digits are garbled; where Ordo and body differ I trust the body header chain (Liber tertius 835 vs 833; Adversus eos 935 vs 923; Metochita Notitia 999 vs 929; De lingua 917 vs 947).
The Elenchus has no column for the first, second, Metochita, Blastares and Index items; all are body-only (Ordo cross-checked).
Entered as crossrefs: Pachymeres Scholia in Dionysium (PG 3) and the Argumenta declamationum (PG 143, Elenchus col. 413 vs Ordo 417; target not verified in PG 143).

Omitted editorial matter not in the Elenchus: Index Miscellaneorum Theodori Metochitae; Possinus's Observationes chapter lists; the Syntagma's Praefatio, Prologus, Index capitum and chapter lists. Ordo-only works: none.
